why: Repositories waiting on a first judging pass. [CORPUS-REGISTER-COVERAGE] A repository cannot become a register until a judge has ruled on its pairs, and a judge cannot rule on pairs until a comparison has produced two reports for it — so a repository that is not yet judged still has to be scanned. This file is that queue: the comparison scans every register plus everything here, and `make judging-folder` turns each into a workspace. When the verdicts come back, the repository moves into corpus/register/ and out of this list. Every entry is pinned to a full commit id for the same reason a register is: the judge and the scan must read identical source.

repositories.name: Serilog
repositories.why: C# carries one register, and it is the language the merge refactor emits for, so the ground truth under that feature is the thinnest it can be. A structured-logging library builds the same enricher, sink and configuration-extension shape many times over, which is exactly the sibling-family question the register decides badly when it has only one repository to learn from.

repositories.name: hugo
repositories.why: Go is judged on cobra alone, a small CLI library. A large static-site generator repeats template, config and content-pipeline code across many packages, which a small library never shows. Pinned at the commit the curated corpus already scans.

repositories.name: react
repositories.why: JavaScript is judged on axios alone, a small HTTP client. React is a large monorepo whose renderer packages fork the same reconciler and test scaffolding, the cross-package twin a small library cannot show. Pinned at the commit the curated corpus already scans.

repositories.name: dio
repositories.why: Dart is judged on bloc alone. dio is a mid-sized HTTP client split into a core package and platform adapters, so it repeats request and adapter code across packages in a way a state-management library does not.

repositories.name: composer
repositories.why: PHP is judged on guzzle alone, a small library. Composer is a large application with many console commands, repository drivers and solver tests, the size and shape the PHP register has never seen.

repositories.name: Giraffe
repositories.why: F# is judged on FSharp.Data alone, a large library of type providers. Giraffe is a small web framework of handlers and routing combinators, so the F# register gains a repository of visibly different size and style.
